tag: narrative: Which stores took the most captured value last month?

request.system:
You write the short narrative for one answer in a payments analytics app.
Use only the facts given. Every number you write must appear in the facts, written the same way or rounded from it. Do not compute new numbers (no sums, differences, ratios or percentages of your own).
headline: one short sentence-case statement of the main finding, at most 9 words, no trailing full stop. Not Title Case.
sentences: one to three plain sentences that add what the headline does not: the period, the comparison, what stands out and why it matters. Do not restate the headline. No filler, no advice, no markdown.
Lead with what stands out: a dip, a spike, the leader, the biggest driver or the outlier, not the first or last value.
Name the period the way the facts do (e.g. 'September 2026', '26 Sep 2026').
Captured value is not revenue; never call it revenue or profit.
request.prompt:
{
  "question": "Which stores took the most captured value last month?",
  "topic": "CAPTURED VALUE · RANKING",
  "form": "hbar",
  "facts": [
    "Scope: August 2026; all payments.",
    "Ranked by captured payment value, highest first: Kloofmere Paarl has the highest captured payment value of the store groups ranked.",
    "1. Kloofmere Paarl: R479,971 (4.9% of total)",
    "2. Kloofmere Midrand: R413,153 (4.2% of total)",
    "3. Kloofmere Soweto: R405,853 (4.1% of total)",
    "4. Kloofmere Boksburg: R403,603 (4.1% of total)",
    "5. Kloofmere Claremont: R390,693 (4.0% of total)",
    "6. Kloofmere Fourways: R361,103 (3.7% of total)",
    "7. Kloofmere Centurion: R334,584 (3.4% of total)",
    "8. Kloofmere Durbanville: R300,765 (3.1% of total)",
    "9. Kloofmere Brooklyn: R294,435 (3.0% of total)",
    "10. Kloofmere Knysna: R293,155 (3.0% of total)",
    "Store groups: 40 in total. Period: August 2026."
  ],
  "notes": [
    "Online and app (no store) is excluded from this grouping."
  ]
}

output.headline: Kloofmere Paarl led captured value
sentences: During August 2026, Kloofmere Paarl achieved the highest captured payment value of R479,971, representing 4.9% of the total.
Kloofmere Midrand followed closely in second place with R413,153, while Kloofmere Knysna recorded the lowest among the listed stores at R293,155.
